svg.title: Aegis AI — System and Data-Flow Architecture
svg.desc: Authorized telemetry enters Aegis AI through authenticated Wazuh or generic ingestion paths, becomes canonical alerts, passes deterministic deduplication, correlation version 2, triage version 1, and analyst-controlled promotion into an investigation. PostgreSQL is authoritative, Redis is rebuildable infrastructure, and the optional local AI path creates reviewable claims only.

g.text: Deterministic processing · persisted correlation reasons · analyst-controlled promotion
Entities · Indicators · Relationships · Findings · confirmed MITRE
Attack graph · Notes · Reports · Audit trail
Independent project · Wazuh 4.9.2 is the validated external integration · AI output is never authoritative.
